tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: App ground: transport bar, readout wells, the space between panels.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Panels: session grid, mixer, device chain.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Controls at rest: buttons, empty clip slots, track headers.

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: Hover, pressed, fader caps and knob tracks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panels and rows. Decorative only, never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of buttons, knob caps and fader caps (3:1 against bg-100 and bg-200 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on any bg step.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, units and secondary text, on any bg step (4.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tick marks, empty-slot glyphs, disabled icons. Never text that must be read.

tokens.name: volt
tokens.usage: The brand signal. Playing clips, the play button, knob value arcs, the playhead. As text, on bg-000 and bg-100.

tokens.name: on-volt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a volt fill.

tokens.name: volt-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind volt text: selected scene, active device.

tokens.name: mod
tokens.usage: Modulation only: LFOs, envelopes, modulation rings and routing. As text, on the bg steps or mod-soft.

tokens.name: on-mod
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a mod fill.

tokens.name: mod-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of modulator chips and panels.

tokens.name: record
tokens.usage: Record, arm, recording clips and the clip LED. Nothing else.

tokens.name: on-record
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a record fill.

tokens.name: hot
tokens.usage: Solo, and the meter's top 6 dB. Caution without alarm.

tokens.name: on-hot
tokens.usage: Text on a hot fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px, offset 2px. An alias of mod.

tokens.name: playhead
tokens.usage: Playhead line and clip progress. An alias of volt.

tokens.name: clip-coral
tokens.usage: Clip and track colour. Always with on-clip text.

tokens.name: clip-amber
tokens.usage: Clip and track colour. Always with on-clip text.

tokens.name: clip-teal
tokens.usage: Clip and track colour. Always with on-clip text.

tokens.name: clip-blue
tokens.usage: Clip and track colour. Always with on-clip text.

tokens.name: clip-violet
tokens.usage: Clip and track colour. Always with on-clip text.

tokens.name: clip-pink
tokens.usage: Clip and track colour. Always with on-clip text.

tokens.name: on-clip
tokens.usage: Clip names, clip glyphs and the progress bar on any clip colour, in both themes.

tokens.name: grid-bar
tokens.usage: Bar lines in the timeline grid. An alias of line.

tokens.name: grid-beat
tokens.usage: Beat lines in the timeline grid: present, but quieter than bar lines. An alias of bg-200.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Time-selection wash over lanes. Sits under clips, never over them.

tokens.name: key-white
tokens.usage: Natural keys on keyboard strips. Held keys switch to volt.

tokens.name: key-black
tokens.usage: Sharp keys on keyboard strips; darker than key-white in both themes.

families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Dense by design: the UI lives between 10 and 13px. Display sizes are for the cover and onboarding only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Splash, onboarding and marketing. Never inside the workspace.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Drag a modulator onto any parameter to route it.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Parameter names under knobs and section labels, uppercase.

groups.name: Numbers
groups.note: Every value that changes while you listen is mono with tabular figures, so digits never jitter.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside controls: icon to label, meter channel gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between controls in a row; clip slot padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between groups of controls.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between panels in roomy layouts; cover insets.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing in settings and onboarding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Clip slots, meters, fader caps: the grid stays crisp.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, readouts, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, device cards, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Modulator chips only, so modulation reads as a different kind of object.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Height of buttons and readouts.

tokens.name: size-clip
tokens.usage: Height of a clip slot / scene row.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Track header height.

tokens.name: size-knob
tokens.usage: Standard knob diameter; 24px in mixer strips.

tokens.name: size-lane
tokens.usage: Default track lane height in the timeline; the header matches it.

tokens.name: size-lane-auto
tokens.usage: Automation lane height.

tokens.name: size-ruler
tokens.usage: Timeline ruler height.

tokens.name: size-track-head
tokens.usage: Width of the track header column.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers and menus only. Panels are flat.
